name: Planar Bridge
description: The Planar Bridge is Rashmi's portal device that transports objects and people across planes, later found inside Tezzeret's chest.

status.text: As of January 2025 the Planar Bridge is recalled as the invention that revealed other worlds, and the material shows no later fate for it.

citations.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra destroys the Planar Bridge with a fireblast shielded by Gideon, and Tezzeret inserts its core into himself and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: grabbed the core piece of the Planar Bridge, inserting it into his midsection, and then planeswalking away to his mysterious master

citation.text: "Aether Revolt (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret has Rashmi expand the device into the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret had Rashmi expand the device into the Planar Bridge

citation.text: "Plane", section "The Planar Bridge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas uses the Planar Bridge to steal the Immortal Sun and to transport his Eternals.
timeline.quote: Bolas would later use the Planar Bridge to steal the Immortal Sun and later to transport his army of Eternals during the War of the Spark.

citation.text: "Plane", section "The Planar Bridge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana overwhelms Tezzeret at the Planar Bridge; he escapes with the portal's core after Chandra and Gideon crash into it.
timeline.quote: However, Tezzeret managed to escape with the core of the portal intact

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "The Aether Revolt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes Vraska is meant to call Tezzeret to retrieve the Immortal Sun through the Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: It's Tezzeret. He's the one you're meant to call.

citation.text: "Sabotage" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: The Chamber of the Guildpact is destroyed by the Planar Bridge and again in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Destroyed by the Planar Bridge , and again during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

citation.text: "Tenth District", section "Plazas". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret steals the Planar Portal by Bolas's order and builds it into his body.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret took it off the plane, and incorporated it in his body.

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska theorize that Bolas plans to use the bridge to invade Ravnica with an army of immortals while trapping its planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: Jace and Vraska theorized that something on the plane of Ravnica was of extreme interest to Bolas

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret opens the Planar Bridge in the Chamber of the Guildpact, reducing it to rubble, and the Dreadhorde invades Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret opened up the Planar Bridge in the Chamber of the Guildpact on Ravnica, reducing it to rubble

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The portal in Tezzeret's chest explodes, making the larger portal implode; Tezzeret planeswalks away defeated.
timeline.quote: The portal inside Tezerret's chest exploded

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret retreats to the Seekers' Sanctum, where the Wanderer tracks him; he uses the bridge to redirect Ral's lightning.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret used the Planar Bridge to redirect Ral's lightning strikes

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After his victory Tezzeret uses the bridge to orchestrate the abandonment of his fortress, probably intending to be followed.
timeline.quote: he used the Planar Bridge to orchestrate the abandonment of his fortress

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Forsaken". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret serves as the conduit from Amonkhet to Ravnica for the Eternal Dreadhorde.
timeline.quote: he could function as the conduit from Amonkhet to Ravnica for the invasion of the Eternal Dreadhorde

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn, Dack, Ob Nixilis and Samut collapse the portal in Tezzeret's chest; he seals the hole and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Before they could react, he planeswalked away

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "War of the Spark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The bridge sends Vorinclex to Kaldheim to obtain Tyrite and brings him back to New Phyrexia, burning off his organic parts each way.
timeline.quote: The Planar Bridge was used to transport the praetor Vorinclex to the plane of Kaldheim to obtain a sample of Tyrite

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret transports Jin-Gitaxias to and from Kamigawa and kidnaps Tamiyo.
timeline.quote: He also used it to kidnap Tamiyo

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Neon Dynasty". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reveals the glowing Planar Bridge in his chest as a show of trust, and admits it corrupted after carrying the praetors.
timeline.quote: "A show of trust and good faith."

citation.text: "The Side of Freedom" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret transports Urabrask to New Capenna, leaving him badly wounded.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret used the Planar Bridge to transport Urabrask to New Capenna

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Vivien Reid the bridge was corrupted from ferrying Phyrexian forces and praetors across the multiverse.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret revealed the Bridge got corrupted from ferrying Phyrexian forces and the other praetors across the multiverse

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Streets of New Capenna". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A scarlet Planar Bridge opens and carries Sheoldred, Ajani and Karn away from Dominaria.
timeline.quote: it . . . stole him away.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: The bridge sends Sheoldred and Phyrexian forces to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: The Planar Bridge was used to transport Sheoldred and some Phyrexian forces to the plane of Dominaria

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The bridge carries Sheoldred, Ajani and Karn away from the exploding Mana Rig back to New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: away from the exploding Mana Rig back to New Phyrexia

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn promises Tezzeret a darksteel body for the use of his Planar Bridge.
timeline.quote: After promising Tezzeret a darksteel body in exchange for his help

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Vorinclex on Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Burnt out, Tezzeret is granted a darksteel body by Elesh Norn and the Planar Bridge is removed; its fate is unknown.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn granted him the darksteel body

citation.text: "Planar Bridge", section "Phyrexia: All Will Be One". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ishikari climbs her workshop tower, recalling how Rashmi's Planar Bridge revealed other worlds.
timeline.quote: Up the stairs she goes.
